title: 美股AI链强反弹映射A/H算力，中际旭创回购与行云订单待开盘确认
summary: 11月23日美股AI链强劲反弹，纳指涨6.51%、费城半导体指数涨14%，Moomoo行业榜半导体涨18.00%，CPU、IDC、存储等概念居前；11月24日08:20 CST股指期货接近平盘，显示反弹后动能暂歇。A股上一交易日创业板涨3.08%、4658股上涨，港股15:30快照恒生科技跌0.07%。中际旭创20亿至40亿元回购与行云科技2.99亿元算力服务合同提供直接催化，但公告后尚无今日价格确认；英力特复牌重组与圣诺医药折价配售保留为回避风险。

重大新闻汇总
国际
美股AI链强劲反弹，但仍属高波动修复
11月23日道指、标普500和纳指分别上涨3.01%、4.73%和6.51%，英伟达涨31.5%，费城半导体指数涨14%；大涨修复了上周部分跌幅，但不消除估值与政策风险。 来源
榜单
半导体、硬件与数据中心成为隔夜最强方向
当前快照显示半导体、半导体设备、计算机硬件、电气设备和电子元件行业涨10.58%至18.00%；CPU、IDC、区块链、存储和脑机接口概念涨18.08%至25.19%。 来源
夜盘
股指期货接近平盘，现金时段反弹后动能暂歇
截至11月24日08:20 CST附近，道指与标普500期货约涨0.1%，纳指100期货约跌0.1%；这是隔夜大涨后的轻微背离，不构成已确认反转。 来源
政策
首批18只主动ETF集中上市
沪深交易所各有9只首批主动ETF于11月23日上市，合计募集约360亿元；产品建仓与透明度提升有助投资端扩容，但不能直接等同于当日增量买盘。 来源
政策
“一老一小”方案强化养老托育科技应用
发改委等四部门明确2030年护理型床位占比73%、社区养老设施覆盖率70%，并鼓励智能管理、健康监测、服务机器人、智能穿戴和外骨骼等产品。 来源

中际旭创拟回购20亿至40亿元A股

公司拟发行股份购买宝丰光伏100%股权，审计、评估和交易价格尚未完成；控股权转让与全面要约并行，11月24日复牌波动风险较高。 来源

圣诺医药-B折价配售形成稀释压力
公司拟以每股3.25港元发行533.54万股，较11月23日收市价3.70港元折让约12.16%；融资用途未抵消即时折价和摊薄风险。 来源

A股宽度强、港股科技仍偏弱
AKShare 11月23日数据录得上证涨0.15%、创业板涨3.08%，4658股上涨、782股下跌；港股15:30快照恒生科技跌0.07%，A/H科技映射仍需本地开盘确认。 来源

美股夜盘行情总结

指数确认
指数确认
11月23日现金时段道指、标普500、纳指分别涨3.01%、4.73%、6.51%，确认AI链超跌修复；11月24日08:20 CST道指与标普期货约+0.1%、纳指100期货约-0.1%，显示反弹后暂歇。
板块背离
板块背离
NVDA、AXTI、FFR、XCH、LINK、SKYQ、OSCR、AIOK、PROP、DDS、SKHY在本轮没有可核验的运行时个股夜盘报价；行业/概念现金榜广度强，但当前纳指期货微跌，属于轻微背离。
A/H潜在反转
A/H潜在反转
A股上一交易日创业板涨3.08%、宽度强，港股15:30恒生科技仅跌0.07%；隔夜半导体与CPU/IDC强势可映射CPO、算力和存储，但只有本地开盘放量跑赢才构成潜在反转确认。

盘前结论

事实：11月23日美股AI链强反弹、A股宽度强，但港股科技仅近乎持平；11月24日08:20 CST美股期货接近平盘。

判断：隔夜半导体、CPU、IDC与存储强势可映射A/H算力链，中际旭创回购和行云科技合同提供公司级催化；由于公告后今日价格尚未形成，只能条件关注。

不确定性：极端单日涨幅可能回吐；英力特重组定价未定、圣诺医药折价配售等负面反证必须保留。

重点个股关注

中际旭创
300308.SZ / 03308.HK
条件关注
事实与状态：拟回购20亿至40亿元A股、上限600元/股；11月23日A股收417.20元、涨6.10%，但公告收盘后发布，缺少公告后价格反馈。 来源
确认条件：A/H开盘后放量跑赢CPO与恒生科技，并由实际回购成交或订单交付继续验证。
风险与失效条件：若高开回落、弱于CPO板块，或AI政策与估值风险再度压制，维持观察而不升级。
行云科技
300209.SZ
条件关注
事实与状态：签署2.9856亿元、5年期、32套GPU算力服务合同；公告收盘后披露，未取得今日开盘价，不能声称实时确认。 来源
确认条件：开盘量价跑赢算力服务板块，且客户履约、交付验收和回款节奏得到后续公告支持。
风险与失效条件：订单集中、资本开支与回款风险上升，或股价弱于算力链时，条件关注失效。
英力特
000635.SZ
回避
事实与状态：停牌后拟发行股份购买宝丰光伏100%股权，交易价格与评估未定；11月24日复牌前没有新价格反馈，且控制权转让触发全面要约。 来源
重新评估条件：复牌后波动收敛、成交价格明显高于要约与停牌前参考，且审计估值和发行条款清晰。
风险与失效条件：定价、审批、稀释或重组终止风险占优；在关键条款明确前维持回避。
圣诺医药-B
02257.HK
回避
事实与状态：拟以3.25港元配售533.54万股，较11月23日收市价3.70港元折让12.16%，属于可核验的即时稀释与折价反证。 来源
重新评估条件：融资用途形成可量化里程碑、股价消化折价并重新站稳配售价与前收市价。
风险与失效条件：摊薄、资金消耗与临床研发不确定性延续时，维持回避，不能包装成融资利好。

板块轮动看板

结构线索

半导体、CPU、IDC、存储与硬件同步居前，直接映射A/H的CPO、算力服务器、芯片设备与存储链。

本地确认

中际旭创与行云科技拥有回购和合同催化，但都缺少公告后今日价格反馈，只能条件关注。

压力方向

综合油气、医疗计划与百货居后；圣诺医药折价配售、英力特重组定价未定构成明确反证。

验证信号

观察A/H科技开盘相对强弱、成交量、港股科技广度，以及美股期货能否从接近平盘重新转强。

逻辑链

美股半导体+18.00%、CPU概念+25.19%、IDC概念+24.97% → 全球AI链出现现金时段强修复 → A/H优先验证CPO、算力与存储。
中际旭创大额回购 + 行云科技算力合同 → 公司级催化与隔夜主题同向 → 公告后尚无本地价格确认，只列条件关注。
纳指现金时段+6.51%但08:20 CST纳指100期货约-0.1% → 反弹后动能暂歇 → 不把隔夜涨幅机械外推为今日追涨指令。
英力特复牌重组条款未定 + 圣诺医药折价配售 → 交易与稀释风险可核验 → 明确回避，等待条款和价格重新确认。

风险雷达

AI链单日涨幅极端，费城半导体指数涨14%、行业榜半导体涨18%，次日获利回吐和波动放大风险高。
英力特重组仍缺审计评估与最终定价，复牌时控制权转让、全面要约和发行股份因素叠加。
圣诺医药配售价较前收市价折让12.16%，稀释和融资后现金消耗压力不能被忽略。
中际旭创回购上限并非必然成交价或完成金额，实际执行节奏仍需公告验证。
AKShare港股数据是11月23日15:30快照而非最终收盘；今日开盘前不存在可验证的A/H实时价格。

数据来源与时间点

国内发现源：东方财富、上海证券报、第一财经与公开盘前汇总；原始政策/交易所来源：国家发改委、上交所、巨潮资讯、港交所及上市公司公告，抓取截至2026-11-24 08:38 CST。A/H行情：GitHub Actions AKShare快照，抓取于2026-11-23 15:40 CST；A股为11月23日收盘，港股为15:30盘中快照。国际行情：Reuters、Investor's Business Daily；榜单：Moomoo GitHub Actions快照，抓取于2026-11-24 08:30 CST，覆盖11月23日美股现金时段。个股运行时夜盘报价未取得，未以旧价冒充实时。

Major News
Global
US AI stocks rebounded sharply, but volatility remains high
On Nov 23 the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose 3.01%, 4.73% and 6.51%; Nvidia gained 31.5% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 14%. The move repaired part of last week's losses but did not remove valuation or policy risks. Source

Semiconductors, hardware and data centers led overnight
The current snapshot shows semiconductors, semiconductor equipment, computer hardware, electrical equipment and electronic components up 10.58%-18.00%; CPU, IDC, blockchain, storage and brain-computer-interface concepts rose 18.08%-25.19%. Source
Overnight

Around 08:20 CST on Nov 24, Dow and S&P 500 futures were about +0.1% while Nasdaq-100 futures were about -0.1%. This is a mild divergence after the surge, not a confirmed reversal. Source
Policy
The first 18 active ETFs began trading
Nine first-batch active ETFs listed on each of the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges on Nov 23, raising about RMB36 billion in total. Broader products and transparency support the investment side but do not guarantee same-day inflows. Source
Policy
The elderly and childcare plan expands technology use
Four ministries set 2030 targets of 73% nursing-care beds and 70% community elder-care facility coverage, while encouraging smart management, health monitoring, service robots, wearables and exoskeletons. Source
Company
InnoLight plans a RMB2-4 billion A-share buyback
The price cap is RMB600 per share and the term is no more than three months. The stock closed at RMB417.20, up 6.10%, on Nov 23, but the announcement came after the close, so there is no post-announcement price confirmation yet. Source
Company
Xingyun signed a RMB299 million GPU compute-services contract
The company will provide 32 standardized GPU compute-service sets for five years, with a tax-inclusive value of RMB298.56 million. It was disclosed after the close; opening price/volume and collection execution remain unverified. Source
Company
Yinglite disclosed a Baofeng Solar restructuring plan and resumes trading
The company plans to buy 100% of Baofeng Solar through share issuance, while audit, valuation and final pricing remain incomplete. A control transfer and mandatory offer run in parallel, raising resumption volatility risk. Source
Hong Kong
Sirnaomics-B discounted placement creates dilution pressure
The company plans to issue 5.3354 million shares at HKD3.25, about 12.16% below the Nov 23 close of HKD3.70. Funding needs do not remove the immediate discount and dilution risk. Source
Market
A-share breadth was strong while Hong Kong tech lagged
AKShare data for Nov 23 showed Shanghai +0.15%, ChiNext +3.08%, with 4,658 advancers and 782 decliners. The 15:30 Hong Kong snapshot had Hang Seng TECH -0.07%, so local opening confirmation is still required. Source

US Overnight Trading Summary

Index confirmation
Index confirmation
The Nov 23 cash session confirmed an AI rebound with the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq up 3.01%, 4.73% and 6.51%. At 08:20 CST on Nov 24, Dow and S&P futures were about +0.1% and Nasdaq-100 futures about -0.1%, showing a pause after the rebound.
Sector divergence
Sector divergence
No verifiable runtime overnight quotes were obtained for NVDA, AXTI, FFR, XCH, LINK, SKYQ, OSCR, AIOK, PROP, DDS or SKHY. Cash-session industry/concept breadth was strong, while slightly negative Nasdaq futures represent a mild divergence.
Potential A/H reversal
Potential A/H reversal
ChiNext rose 3.08% with strong breadth in the prior A-share session, while Hang Seng TECH was only -0.07% at the 15:30 snapshot. Overnight strength in chips and CPU/IDC maps to CPO, compute and storage, but a potential reversal requires local opening outperformance on volume.

Pre-market Takeaway

Fact: US AI stocks rebounded sharply and A-share breadth was strong on Nov 23, while Hong Kong tech was nearly flat; US futures were near flat at 08:20 CST on Nov 24.

View: Overnight strength in semiconductors, CPU, IDC and storage maps to the A/H compute chain, with company catalysts from InnoLight and Xingyun; without today's post-announcement price action, both remain conditional watches.

Uncertainty: Extreme one-day gains may reverse; Yinglite's unfinished pricing and Sirnaomics' discounted placement remain explicit counter-evidence.

Key Stock Focus

InnoLight
300308.SZ / 03308.HK
Conditional Watch
Facts and status: Planned RMB2-4 billion A-share buyback with a RMB600 cap. The A share closed at RMB417.20, +6.10%, on Nov 23, but the announcement came after the close, so post-announcement price feedback is missing. Source
Confirmation: A/H shares outperform CPO and Hang Seng TECH on volume, supported by actual buyback execution or order-delivery evidence.
Risk/invalidation: A gap-up reversal, underperformance versus CPO, or renewed AI policy/valuation pressure keeps the stock at watch rather than bullish.
Xingyun Technology
300209.SZ
Conditional Watch
Facts and status: Signed a RMB298.56 million five-year contract for 32 GPU compute-service sets. It was disclosed after the close and today's opening quote is unavailable, so no real-time confirmation is claimed. Source
Confirmation: Opening price and volume outperform compute services, with later disclosure supporting customer performance, acceptance and collections.
Risk/invalidation: Rising customer concentration, capex or collection risk, or underperformance versus the compute chain invalidates the watch.
Yinglite
000635.SZ
Avoid
Facts and status: After suspension, the company plans to issue shares for 100% of Baofeng Solar; pricing and valuation are unfinished. There is no new pre-resumption price feedback, while the control transfer triggers a mandatory offer. Source
Reassessment: Post-resumption volatility settles, price clearly holds above offer/pre-suspension references, and audit, valuation and issuance terms become clear.
Risk/invalidation: Pricing, approval, dilution and termination risks dominate; avoid until key terms are resolved.
Sirnaomics-B
02257.HK
Avoid
Facts and status: Proposed 5.3354 million-share placement at HKD3.25, a 12.16% discount to the Nov 23 close of HKD3.70, providing verifiable dilution and discount evidence. Source
Reassessment: Use of proceeds produces measurable milestones and the stock absorbs the discount, reclaiming both the placement price and prior close.
Risk/invalidation: Continued dilution, cash burn and clinical uncertainty warrant avoidance; the financing must not be presented as bullish.

Sector Rotation Board

Structural signal

Semiconductors, CPU, IDC, storage and hardware all rank near the top, mapping directly to A/H CPO, compute servers, chip equipment and storage.

Local confirmation

InnoLight and Xingyun have buyback/contract catalysts, but both lack today's post-announcement price feedback and remain conditional watches.

Pressure

Integrated oil/gas, healthcare plans and department stores lag; Sirnaomics' discount placement and Yinglite's unfinished pricing are explicit counter-evidence.

Validation signals

Watch A/H tech relative strength and volume, Hong Kong tech breadth, and whether near-flat US futures turn higher again.

Logic Chain

US semiconductors +18.00%, CPU concepts +25.19% and IDC concepts +24.97% → a strong cash-session AI-chain recovery → prioritize local confirmation in CPO, compute and storage.
InnoLight's large buyback + Xingyun's compute contract → company catalysts align with the overnight theme → without post-announcement local price confirmation, both remain conditional watches.
Nasdaq cash +6.51% but Nasdaq-100 futures about -0.1% at 08:20 CST → momentum paused after the rebound → do not mechanically convert overnight gains into a chase signal.
Unfinished Yinglite restructuring terms + Sirnaomics' discounted placement → verifiable deal and dilution risks → avoid until terms and price are reconfirmed.

Risk Radar

The one-day AI move was extreme: the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 14% and the industry ranking 18%, creating high profit-taking and volatility risk.
Yinglite still lacks completed audit, valuation and final pricing, while control transfer, mandatory offer and share issuance overlap at resumption.
Sirnaomics' placement price is 12.16% below the prior close; dilution and post-financing cash-burn pressure remain material.
InnoLight's cap is not a guaranteed execution price or amount; actual buyback progress still requires disclosure.
AKShare Hong Kong data is a Nov 23 15:30 snapshot, not a final close; no verifiable real-time A/H quote exists before today's open.
